job.job_description:
Build the engine that resolves OSINT, HUMINT, GEOINT, FININT and sensor data into one entity graph with a defensible confidence score and a provable chain of evidence.

What youll do
Design entity resolution, graph and scoring systems across multiple intelligence sources.
Implement confidence scoring with a complete, audit-trailed evidence chain.
Build geospatial and pattern-of-life analytics over fused entities.
Partner with analysts to ensure outputs hold up to operational scrutiny.
What we look for
Experience with graph data, entity resolution or data-fusion systems.
Strong backend engineering (Python/Go/Java) and graph/database fundamentals.
Comfort reasoning about uncertainty, provenance and explainability.
Bonus: exposure to intelligence, defense or geospatial domains.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
